name: A Mexico City rooftop garden

place_source.title: Wikidata: Mexico City (Q1489), coordinate location and elevation above sea level

blurb: A rooftop garden above Mexico City: potted palms, agaves and prickly pear around a small courtyard, visited by doves, finches, grackles and hummingbirds by day, and by opossums and ringtails after dark.

facts.text: Mexico City has a subtropical highland climate (Köppen Cwb) with mild temperatures year-round and a pronounced rainy season from June to October.

source.title: Wikipedia: Mexico City

facts.text: Mexico City sits at an elevation of about 2,240 metres in the Valley of Mexico, surrounded by mountains and volcanoes.

facts.text: The city is home to a rich birdlife including house sparrows, Inca doves, house finches, great-tailed grackles, vermilion flycatchers and hummingbirds.

source.title: Wikipedia: Mexico City
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Mexico City", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: Virginia opossums and ringtails are common nocturnal mammals in Mexico City's parks and gardens.
